protocol: authored support replay; frozen mixed memory; synthetic-v1

exceptions: Only the first page is requested.
candidate.lesson: When all records are requested, fetch successive cursors until next_cursor is null.
preconditions: All records are requested from a cursor-paginated API.
candidate.trigger: Fetch all records using cursor pagination.

exceptions: A non-idempotent write may already have committed.
candidate.lesson: Retry a read once after a transient error; do not retry non-idempotent writes after an ambiguous timeout.
preconditions: A read-only request returned a transient error.

exceptions: API v2 fixes the ordering and already returns ascending records.
candidate.lesson: Reverse list_records output on API v1 when ascending order is requested; v1 returns descending records.
preconditions: API version is v1 and ascending order is requested.
candidate.trigger: Work around reversed ordering in API version v1.
